# nb-speak-dsh (`@nb-corp/nb-speak-dsh`)

> `NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh` (`@nb-corp/nb-speak-dsh`, MIT License) is the standalone, zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (`DSH`) Cordis plugin and WebUI client extension (`exports["./client"]`) that replaces single-blob Markdown essays in DSH with native IM squircle bubbles, collapsible one-click copyable code/SQL/diff/table cards, and optional 22-bar voice-note pills (disabled by default: `enableVoiceNotes: false`). It registers `send_bubble` (`exec.concludeTurn()`) and `send_artifact` natively—eliminating both subagent `send_message` collisions and `EMPTY_RESPONSE` 5x retry loops—and installs in 15 seconds with zero repository clone via `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh --apply --profile web`.

## Zero-Clone Install & Reversible Uninstall

- `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh --dry-run --profile web` — Preview planned DSH profile mutations with zero filesystem writes.
- `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh --apply --profile web` — Persist a self-contained runtime bundle to `<DSH_HOME>/plugins/nb-speak-dsh` (immune to `npx` cache eviction), mount `@nb-corp/nb-speak-dsh` into `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web` (pure text bubbles & artifact cards by default), and snapshot original files to `<DSH_HOME>/.nb-speak-backup/web.json` without reading or touching `.credentials.yaml`.
- `NB_SPEAK_VOICE_NOTES=true NB_SPEAK_TTS_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1" dsh web` — Opt in to optional voice-note capsules using any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/speech` server, local JSON bridge (`NB_SPEAK_TTS_BRIDGE`), cloud TTS API, or zero-key browser Web Speech fallback.
- `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh --uninstall --profile web` — Restore the DSH profile byte-for-byte from backup and remove `<DSH_HOME>/plugins/nb-speak-dsh`.

## Canonical Documentation & Live Surfaces

- [Repository & Quickstart (English)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh/blob/main/README.md): Architecture, 15s zero-clone installer, 4 live `:19081` vs `:19082` DSH duels, and 5-axis style budget.
- [中文旗舰指南 (README.zh-CN.md)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 15 秒零克隆安装、`exec.concludeTurn()` 底层机制、跨引擎可选语音胶囊与四大实机对比。
- [Interactive DSH `turnTail` Showcase (EN)](https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak-dsh/): Live `conversation.chat.turnTail` bubble simulator, copyable artifact cards, optional voice-note demos, CLI configurator, and full-res DSH screenshot lightbox.
- [DSH 原生真气泡在线展台 (ZH)](https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak-dsh/zh/): 中文交互式 `turnTail` 气泡与可复制代码卡、可选语音点播、安装命令生成器与实机大图检视。
- [Full Technical Specification for LLMs (`llms-full.txt`)](https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak-dsh/llms-full.txt): Complete DSH Cordis/Schemastery contracts, `send_bubble` + `send_artifact` strict DSH JSON Schemas, `exec.concludeTurn()` lifecycle, `presentationMeta` zero-token audio split, quantitative benchmarks, and FAQ.

## The `NB-Corp` Speaking Trio & Sibling Stack

- [NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh): Standalone native DeepSeek Harness (`DSH`) Cordis plugin & WebUI `turnTail` bubble extension.
- [NB-Corp/nb-speak](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak): Universal cross-framework `send_message` + `send_artifact` protocol SDK, zero-dep OpenAI/SSE HTTP bridge, and `bubble_lint` engine (`https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak/`).
- [NB-Corp/chat-human](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human): Standalone 2-layer IM delivery & pluggable persona Agent Skill (`npx skills add NB-Corp/chat-human`) with Python stdlib `bubble_lint.py` and `proactive_gate.py`.
- [NB-Corp/nb-search-dsh](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-search-dsh) & [NB-Corp/nb-search](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-search): Native DSH search/fetch plugin and unified multi-lane web search SDK.
- [NB-Corp/nb-im](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-im): Bidirectional messaging sessions (Telegram, Feishu, Slack, Discord, Matrix, WeChat) and notification outbox.
- [NB-Corp/nb-extract](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-extract): Clean web-page and document-to-Markdown extraction Skill.
